messages:
marie: Quick heads-up — I just saved a routing config in Console that slipped past lint: header regex ended up as a catch-all and routed to an unstable backend. console said ‘Saved’ so app outage risk.

alex: can you paste the YAML you used?

marie: ```yaml
routes:
  - match:
      path: /api/*
      headers:
        - name: X-Env
          regex: ".*"
    override:
      backend: unstable-canary
```

jordan: ouch. The schema can't express "this regex is a no-op" — that's semantic. We do have some linter rules but they don't catch trivial catch-alls like `.*` or `^.*$`.

sam: Proposal: add a heuristic rule in the Console preflight linter: flag header regexes that are exactly `.*`, `^.*$`, or are shorter than 3 chars and contain only wildcards. Mark as WARNING by default, ERROR under strict saves.

alex: +1. UX should show the warning inline in the preview diff, not just a toast. Offer two actions: "apply suggested anchor" (autofix) or "save anyway" with a short justification required.

jordan: Implementation notes:
- client-side lint hook runs before save, returns structured list of issues.
- server validates same rules in the config API (mirror ruleset) so we don't accept bypasses.
- add unit tests: console-lint-e2e covers the preview pipeline and server-sync.

marie: For autofix, suggestion could be to anchor the regex: `^.*$` -> `^$`? wait no — anchoring `.*` to something useful is tricky. Better autofix to suggest `^<value>$` if a sample exists, otherwise suggest explicit header matchers (e.g., exact values) or add a confirm dialog that explains risk.

sam: Right, autofix for `.*` is dangerous. Better to offer a templated quickfix that replaces `.*` with `^ENV:[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$` only when route metadata indicates env header pattern. Otherwise only propose: "Replace with specific value" or "Keep wildcard (acknowledge risk)".

lint-bot: CI note: rule `header-regex-heuristic` added to staging-lint.yml. New tests failing in console-e2e/preview-lint on branch fix/regex-heuristics.

alex: OK. Action items: 1) Jordan to draft linter rule PR + test cases (include `.*`, `^.*$`, `(.|\n)*`), 2) Sam to update server-side validator to mirror ruleset, 3) Marie to mock UX flows (inline diff + quickfix modal) and send to PM for default level decision, 4) add e2e test asserting save-block when strict mode enabled.

jordan: I'll open the PR with rule + test matrix. Will add a small dataset of edge regexes.

marie: thanks — also let's capture this in the routing docs under "linting and preflight" so support can reference the behavior. :eyes:
